notes.title: Digital Deluxe Content released!
notes.content:
The TWO WORLDS DIGITAL DELUXE CONTENT includes: 

- The Art of Two Worlds: Digital Artbook (82 Pages, PDF Format)
- Full-HD Wallpaper
- Moveshots & MoCap Videos
- 4 exclusive In-Game Items (Valermos - Sword of Fire, Armor of Darkness, Spear of Destiny and The Great Bow of Heaven's Fury)
- Two Worlds Pinball (Windows only)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/986290/Two_Worlds_Digital_Deluxe_Content/

notes.title: Update for Windows, Mac and Linux versions available!
notes.content:
Release Notes:
- DRM is removed and exchanged against DLM V2. The activation is no longer mandatory to enjoy the single player campaign. Third party Serial Codes are only required to access the Multiplayer Server and create an account. Activation is optional and grants live time support and updates, restore of the game in case it is lost and change of the platform or content provider.
- Three additional languages added. The game supports now: English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Czech and Spanish.
- Cross-platform Cloud saves support added.
- Linux platform is supported now. The port is based on Wine with CSMT and PhysX hardware support patches enabled.
- Mac OSX platform version supports el Capitan.
